scenicChapters.narrative: For 34 km this is Stelvio Pass, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Stelvio Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2757 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.

stelvio-pass.story: From Prato Allo Stelvio it runs 80 km to Bormio; allow about 1 h 21 of riding. The stops in between: Trafoi and Stelvio Pass. The highest point is about 2,750 m. Stelvio Pass is open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
